protocol: Bump N=3 and RC N=10 alternating AB/BA pairs. RC includes the initial three pairs and seven additional pairs below. Same full CLI source, cli_main entry, RC output. Fresh cache per pair and variant, cold then warm in separate processes. Equal-length compiler/cache/output paths. Production module caches enabled; checked-module, AST, and codegen-body caches disabled. Node wrapper with exnref and stack-size=4000. No CPU profiler in timing runs. heap_ptr is allocator high-water; RSS is the process reading at completion, not peak RSS.
extension_protocol: RC extended from three to ten alternating pairs after the first timing run and warm CPU profiles disagreed in wall-time direction. All seven additional pairs use fresh isolated caches. Report all ten pairs, not only the extension.
extension_harness:
import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, re, statistics, subprocess, time

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
work = root / '_build/symbol2387/compare'
report = json.loads((work / 'results.json').read_text())
assert len(report['runs']) == 24
expected = report['runs'][0]['output_sha256']
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('VIBE_', 'NODE_'))}
env.update(VIBE_PREOPEN_DIR=str(root), VIBE_IMPORT_ABI='raw', VIBE_WASM_MEMORY_STATS='1', VIBE_FS_COMPILE='1', VIBE_BACKEND='wasi', VIBE_RC='1', VIBE_CHECKED_MODULE_CACHE='off', VIBE_EXPERIMENTAL_AST_CACHE='0', VIBE_CODEGEN_BODY_CACHE='off', VIBE_WASM_NAMES='0')
for iteration in range(3, 10):
    for side in ('ab' if iteration % 2 == 0 else 'ba'):
        folder = work / f'rc-{iteration}-{side}'
        folder.mkdir()
        for temperature in ['cold', 'warm']:
            out = folder / 'out.wasm'
            out.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            start = time.monotonic()
            proc = subprocess.run(['bash', 'scripts/run_wasm_vibe_host_runner.sh', '--invoke', 'cli_main', str(work / f'{side}-rc.wasm'), 'lib/@vibe/cli/entry.vibe', str(out), 'cli_main'], env={**env, 'VIBE_BUILD_CACHE_DIR': str(folder / 'cache')}, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
            wall = time.monotonic() - start
            (folder / f'{temperature}.log').write_text(proc.stdout + proc.stderr)
            proc.check_returncode()
            digest = hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            assert digest == expected
            stats = re.findall(r'\[wasm-memory\][^\n]+', proc.stderr)[-1]
            row = {'runtime': 'rc', 'round': iteration, 'variant': side, 'temperature': temperature, 'wall_s': wall, 'output_sha256': digest, 'output_bytes': out.stat().st_size, **{k: int(v) for k, v in re.findall(r'(pages|bytes|heap_ptr|rss)=([0-9]+)', stats)}}
            report['runs'].append(row)
            (work / 'results-extended.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
            print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
report['medians'] = []
for runtime in ['bump', 'rc']:
    for temperature in ['cold', 'warm']:
        row = {'runtime': runtime, 'temperature': temperature}
        for side in 'ab':
            rs = [r for r in report['runs'] if (r['runtime'], r['temperature'], r['variant']) == (runtime, temperature, side)]
            row[side] = {k: statistics.median(r[k] for r in rs) for k in ['wall_s', 'heap_ptr', 'pages', 'rss']}
            row[side]['wall_mean_s'] = statistics.mean(r['wall_s'] for r in rs)
        row['delta_percent'] = {k: (row['b'][k] / row['a'][k] - 1) * 100 for k in row['a']}
        report['medians'].append(row)
        print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
report['extension_protocol'] = 'RC extended from three to ten alternating pairs after the first timing run and warm CPU profiles disagreed in wall-time direction. All seven additional pairs use fresh isolated caches. Report all ten pairs, not only the extension.'
report['extension_harness'] = pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()
(work / 'results-extended.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print('DONE', flush=True)
status: Accepted as a bounded DCE representation refactor and a foundation for further ID-based analyses; an overall RC latency improvement is not established.
design: Private per-pass DceGraph interns a spelling once into a dense ID; AST reference discovery still performs String-to-ID lookups. Deduplication, adjacency, definition chains, statement filtering and the reachability queue then use integer IDs.
Names referenced before their definitions and reference-only names have IDs. Duplicate definitions share a spelling ID and all contribute edges. Output statements remain in source order.
The lexical binder stack remains unchanged. Spelling IDs do not identify lexical bindings. No parser, TypeEnv, public API, worker protocol or persistent-cache identity migration.
The graph owns its tables. The previous process-global reference stamp map and duplicate string-based reachability implementation are removed.
interpretation: DCE hash self-time decreases in both runtimes, but integer-keyed graph traversal does not remove reference-discovery hashing or AST scope scans.
Bump whole-compile medians decrease by about 1%, too small to establish a general wall-time improvement at N=3.

RC was extended to N=10. Cold median increases 2.07% (mean +1.79%); warm median increases 0.67% (mean +4.85%, including slow candidate runs). These results do not justify an RC speedup claim, and the source of the cold latency increase is not isolated.
Allocator high-water falls deterministically by about 10 MB on bump and 13 MB on RC. This is roughly 0.4-0.7% of the full compile, not the 55% reduction of the synthetic dense-graph case.
RC cold linear memory ends 163 pages (10,682,368 bytes) higher despite lower allocator high-water; warm pages are unchanged. Completion RSS is volatile and is not peak RSS.

Adopt the bounded representation change for its deterministic allocation reduction, per-pass state ownership, shared reachability implementation, and a boundary for further ID-based analyses. Retain the measured RC latency tradeoff; this is not a claim that broader symbol interning or an overall RC speedup has landed.

allocation_regression.input: 512 definitions, each referencing up to the previous 16 definitions; long shared-prefix names; last definition is the root; one warm-up DCE call before measuring.
allocation_regression.red: The budget fails on unchanged main; all 512 definitions are retained.
allocation_regression.green: The budget passes with the candidate in both bump and RC tests.
allocation_regression.probe: The committed test with the allocation assertion replaced by an interpolated println of allocated.

warm_profiles.protocol: Three alternating AB/BA profiles per runtime on the same full CLI source, using the warmed cache and equal-length artifact paths from the timing comparison. DCE inclusive time counts each sample once if its stack contains a core/dce.vibe function. Caller attribution is limited by inlining and missing sampled stacks; profile durations are not uninstrumented wall times.
warm_profiles.harness:
import collections, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, statistics, subprocess

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
work = root / '_build/symbol2387/compare'
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('VIBE_', 'NODE_'))}
env.update(VIBE_PREOPEN_DIR=str(root), VIBE_IMPORT_ABI='raw', VIBE_FS_COMPILE='1', VIBE_BACKEND='wasi', VIBE_RC='1', VIBE_CHECKED_MODULE_CACHE='off', VIBE_EXPERIMENTAL_AST_CACHE='0', VIBE_CODEGEN_BODY_CACHE='off', VIBE_WASM_NAMES='0')
expected = json.loads((work / 'results.json').read_text())['runs'][0]['output_sha256']
rows = []
for runtime in ['bump', 'rc']:
    for iteration in range(3):
        for side in ('ab' if iteration % 2 == 0 else 'ba'):
            folder = work / f'{runtime}-{iteration}-{side}'
            profile = folder / 'warm.cpuprofile'
            assert not profile.exists()
            flags = '\n'.join(['--cpu-prof', f'--cpu-prof-dir={folder}', '--cpu-prof-name=warm.cpuprofile'])
            proc = subprocess.run(['bash', 'scripts/run_wasm_vibe_host_runner.sh', '--invoke', 'cli_main', str(work / f'{side}-{runtime}.wasm'), 'lib/@vibe/cli/entry.vibe', str(folder / 'out.wasm'), 'cli_main'], env={**env, 'VIBE_BUILD_CACHE_DIR': str(folder / 'cache'), 'VIBE_NODE_EXTRA_FLAGS': flags}, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
            (folder / 'warm-profile.log').write_text(proc.stdout + proc.stderr)
            proc.check_returncode()
            assert hashlib.sha256((folder / 'out.wasm').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected
            p = json.loads(profile.read_text())
            nodes = {n['id']: n for n in p['nodes']}
            parent = {c: n['id'] for n in p['nodes'] for c in n.get('children', [])}
            own = collections.Counter()
            dce_inclusive = dce_hash = dce_self = 0
            for sid, dt in zip(p['samples'], p['timeDeltas']):
                name = nodes[sid]['callFrame']['functionName'] or '(anon)'
                own[name] += dt
                chain = []
                while sid in nodes:
                    chain.append(nodes[sid]['callFrame']['functionName'] or '(anon)')
                    sid = parent.get(sid)
                if '_core_dce_vibe' in name:
                    dce_self += dt
                if any('_core_dce_vibe' in fn for fn in chain):
                    dce_inclusive += dt
                    if name.startswith('hash_string_'):
                        dce_hash += dt
            row = {'runtime': runtime, 'round': iteration, 'variant': side, 'temperature': 'warm', 'sampled_ms': sum(own.values())/1000, 'dce_inclusive_ms': dce_inclusive/1000, 'dce_hash_ms': dce_hash/1000, 'dce_self_ms': dce_self/1000, 'self_ms': {k: v/1000 for k,v in own.most_common()}}
            rows.append(row)
            (work / 'profiles.json').write_text(json.dumps({'runs': rows, 'harness': pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()}, indent=2)+'\n')
            print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in row.items() if k!='self_ms'}), flush=True)
print('DONE', flush=True)
